title: Outbound contracts from Vati to RSL systems
scope: Define and emit assumed outbound contracts so results return to RSL: an approved findings pack for the RSL audit case, the lane recommendation and undisputed amount for the Online Refunds Application or PSRM to act on, and an evidence-requested status with a portal deep link

acceptance.text: Versioned outbound contracts (findings pack, lane recommendation, evidence-requested notice) with fixture sinks that identify themselves as fixtures; WSO2 API Manager is the stated route
Only officer-approved items are emitted; nothing sets RSL status, pays, offsets or assesses; emission is idempotent and recorded in the audit ledger
An unavailable RSL sink leaves the item queued and visible as not delivered
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Outbox tests: approved items are emitted once to fixture sinks; unapproved items never leave

evidence.text: integration/rsl_sinks/contracts.py: versioned assumed outbound contracts rsl.<system>.findings_pack|lane_recommendation|evidence_requested.v0-assumed, each stating route wso2_api_manager, its authority (findings_for_rsl_review / recommendation_only / notice_only) and the assumed-shape notice. FixtureRslSink returns receipts with fixture: true and FIXTURE- IDs and opens no network connection (ADR-048). tests/integration/test_rsl_sinks.py 11 OK.

vati_tax.rsl_outbound queues only on an independently approved Vati Decision (findings pack; plus lane recommendation for an Online Refunds claim with a lane proposal) or an officer-authorised Vati Evidence Request; proposed/rejected decisions and non-RSL cases queue nothing and a request withdrawn after queueing is never sent. No contract has a status/payment/offset/assessment field (validator refuses them). One outbox event per item under rsl-outbound:<kind>:<subject>, delivered through the effect ledger; ledger entries rsl_outbound.<kind>.queued and .delivered (message SHA-256, receipt), no duplicate on replay. Disposable site verify-20261112t044122: test_rsl_outbound_bench 9/9 OK; test_rules 14 OK.

An unavailable sink is retryable: the item stays queued (state queued, last_error_code rsl_sink_unavailable, no receipt, no delivered ledger entry) and is delivered once when RSL answers; after the 20-attempt budget it is not_delivered until an operator retries (outbox.api.retry_event). Officers read the states with rsl_outbound.api.get_case_outbound. Bench tests test_unavailable_sink_keeps_the_item_queued_and_visible_as_not_delivered and test_exhausted_budget_is_not_delivered_until_an_operator_retries OK.

Disposable site (frappe_dev.py verify): install and two migrations ok; bench suite 230 tests, failing only reminders/test_reminders_bench (3, pre-existing on main); app tests 587 OK. Frappe-free: tests/integration 279 OK, tests/contracts 135 OK, backend discovery 587 run with only the pre-existing Windows path-separator failure in portal/test_presubmission; ruff, ruff format, mypy clean. Hosted CI does not start (org spending limit).
